sources.organization: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM)
sources.title: Handbook of Energy and Economic Statistics of Indonesia 2025
sources.metric: electricity utilization; generation; installed capacity; PLN peak load
sources.notes: 2025 edition publication date from official handbook index. Consumption includes PLN (including PLN Batam) plus non-PLN. Generation classification changes in 2025; historical production boundary differs. 2025 PLN peak is unaudited.

sources.title: Penetapan Penyesuaian Tarif Tenaga Listrik Juli-September 2026
sources.metric: B-3; I-3; I-4 published regular energy tariff
sources.notes: Direct official PDF visually verified, signed 1 July 2026. B3/I3 offpeak energy 1035.78; 1114.74 is reactive energy, not kWh energy. Effective period ends 2026-09-30; no Q4 schedule verified, so do not claim this is October effective tariff.

sources.organization: PT PLN (Persero); Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
sources.title: Rencana Usaha Penyediaan Tenaga Listrik 2025-2034
sources.metric: PLN electricity sales forecast; data-center-related grid planning
sources.notes: Ministerial decree 188.K/TL.03/MEM.L/2025 dated 26 May 2025. Full 1253-page official PDF recovered through an archived copy of Gatrik publication because live direct PDF was too slow and Gatrik served an HTML app. Table5.67 is PLN sales, not national consumption; no standalone national data-center GWh forecast found.

sources.title: APAC Data Centre Development Pipeline Hits Record in 2025
sources.metric: H2 2025 operational IT load; under construction; planned capacity
sources.notes: Geographical market is Greater Jakarta, not Indonesia national total. Table reports322MW operational,186MW under construction,901MW planned and24.9% colocation vacancy; categories must not be summed as operational demand.

sources.organization: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi)
sources.title: Indonesia Kejar Posisi Ekonomi Digital Terbesar Asia Lewat AI
sources.metric: reported data-center count and capacity; government capacity target
sources.notes: Press release77/HM-KKD/5/2026 reports185data centers and274MW, with target above2000MW2029. IT vs facility load and census coverage not disclosed; conflicts with GreaterJakarta322MWITindustryestimate and is excluded from IT modeling.

sources.title: APAC Data Centre Development Pipeline Sets New Record in H1 2026
sources.metric: H1 2026 development pipeline and under-construction capacity
sources.notes: Jakarta development pipeline1699MW includes395MW under construction; planned remainder1304MW is analyst subtraction. No Jakarta operational total stated in the release, so retain H2 2025 operational observation separately.

indonesia_electricity.mix_formula: Sum matching PLN own + PLN purchases + IUPTLS/PPU generation components /494353GWh *100. Gas70154; hydro30736; geothermal17740; solar1522; bioenergy+wind28410GWh. Coal unknown: steam334346GWh is not explicitly all coal.

electricity_tariffs.notes: Published energy component; excludes negotiated premiums, minimum-bill effects, taxes and reactive charges. No Q4 2026 confirmation. Offpeak LWBP for >200kVA. Monthly minimum:40hours*connectedkVA*LWBP tariff. Reactive charge1114.74Rp/kVArh if average monthly PF<0.85.

Published energy component; excludes negotiated premiums, minimum-bill effects, taxes and reactive charges. No Q4 2026 confirmation. Peak WBP=K*1035.78Rp/kWh,1.4<=K<=2.0, set by PLN according to local system load. No universal blended flat tariff.
